body: Lane B #4 derived the correct offsets from the PE spec but was read-only on BINARY_ANALYSIS turf; applied here: opt+112->+108 (PE32+), +96->+92 (PE32). Live proof on 3.15t: netsh.exe 0 rows before (lane-B evidence) to 24 rows after, first five symbols byte-identical to lane-B's correct-tuple prediction (ConvertGuidToString, ConvertStringToGuid, DisplayMessageM...), num_rvas=16 at the fixed offset; python.exe stub yields 1 import row. Fix carries a spec-offset comment so the next reader never re-derives it.

title: 548 habit-lazy sites NOT bulk-hoisted: import-time side effects forbid it
body: Classifier tally 548 HABIT across 138 files, but each hoist needs its own import smoke: f22-07 proved module import can execute diagram writers that overwrite tracked files (AOA_STRUCTURE.html restored from HEAD). Bulk top-level conversion would re-trigger every such side effect at import time. Per-site conversion with status-check-after-smoke is the only safe shape; recorded per-file in the edge map, not executed here.

title: Claim-guard rejection resolved by precision, not bypass
body: Third slice commit blocked by the claim guard with no line detail. Rejected text contained two unverifiable-from-the-diff claims: a paragraph about foreign worktree files (true in status, unprovable in the diff) and declaration-style completions. Rewrite kept only diff-provable claims (per-file diff sizes, exact test names with counts, merge tool output quoted) and moved the foreign-turf note out of the message; landed clean with no ALLOW_CLAIM_GUARD. Rule applied from lane-B #17 verbatim.
